summary: Reproduced the global ROCm workaround and missing DSV4 defaults, then scoped thinking/high to the DSV4 encoder and disabled the ROCm-7.0-alpha padding workaround only for the gfx950-rocm720 image while preserving explicit overrides and other image/model defaults.

tests.what_was_measured: 138 tests and 70 subtests covering DSV4 prompt defaults, request/environment precedence, unchanged non-DSV4 behavior, and Docker stage scoping.
On MI355X/gfx950, flag 0 selected MAX_LEN and flag 1 selected SUM_LEN; a PyTorch ROCm elementwise result matched an independent CPU reference with max absolute error 4.76837158203125e-07.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-425310c0892f/raw/gpu-and-flag-evidence.log identifies AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 and records the successful CPU-vs-GPU comparison.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights were unavailable, so full-model semantic quality and accuracy were not validated.
No distributed DP-attention workload was run; the ROCM700A evidence verifies its actual branch selection, not distributed performance or correctness.
The complete production image was not rebuilt; the Dockerfile stage regression validates inheritance and preservation of the other stage defaults.
